Only 22% of remote USD jobs on Loker Dollar list a pay figure. The rest are marked DOE (determined on experience), leaving you to guess the salary that matches your expertise.

Our data from 4,280 active remote listings shows:
• 22% (940 listings) disclose a concrete USD salary
• 78% (3,340 listings) leave pay blank, implying DOE
• 64% (2,735) accept applicants from any country
• 1,213 listings posted in the last 7 days

Example: Online Consumer Panels America offers $25–$45/hour for product assessments.

DOE isn't always a red flag—it can be a negotiation lever. Use global benchmarks, quantify your impact, and anchor with a range.

Browse the latest DOE listings and start the conversation today: https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/what-is-doe-wage
